subject: planner: constant folding to isnull(not null column) (#62046)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: adds `constraint.DeleteTrueExprsBySchema` to strip always-true `not(isnull(col))` when `col` is NOT NULL per child schema before join predicate pushdown (`pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go:~296`, `pkg/planner/core/constraint/exprs.go`). Checked join predicate pushdown flow (including outer-join handling) and the exact match conditions (only `UnaryNot(IsNull(Column))` with `HasNotNullFlag`), and found no plausible correctness/SQL-semantics Blocker/High regression: it only removes predicates that are tautologies given the child’s schema nullability. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes specifically to `DeleteTrueExprsBySchema`/callsite (no evidence of a later fix needed for this logic).
